file_id: Binay Bairagi vs Unknown on 5 February, 2026

sentences.text: Binay Bairagi vs Unknown on 5 February, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 05.02.2026

Kausik (Rejected) CRM (M) 147 of 2026 In Re: An Application for Bail under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 in connection with Bongaon Police Station Case No. 626 of 2024 dated 25.06.2024 under Sections 420/467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 14 of Foreigners Act.
And In the matter of : Binay Bairagi ......Petitioner.

entities.text: Bongaon Police Station Case No. 626 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Mr. Santanu Talukdar Mr. Monojit Debnath Mr. Shwashwitwik Chatterjee ......for the Petitioner.
Ms. Faria Hossain, Ld. APP Mr. Sujan Chatterjee ......for the State.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that petitioner is in custody for 9 months and has been unnecessarily detained in custody.
Learned advocate for the State produces the case diary and draws the attention of the Court to the report which reflects that originally the petitioner is from Khulna.
Having considered the nature of the accusations, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner in CRM(M) 147 of 2026 is dismissed.
All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
